title: Verify: Sound and settings store unit tests
summary: Unit tests for sound and settings flags.
description: Add tests to tests/uiStore.test.ts for sound and settings flags.
acceptance_criteria: Given a reset store, When read, Then soundEnabled is true and settingsOpen false
Given a reset store, When toggleSound and toggleSettings run, Then soundEnabled false and settingsOpen true

steps.lines: after the drawer and modal describe block
steps.action: Add describe block resetting state with useUiStore.setState({ soundEnabled: true, settingsOpen: false }). Tests: defaults true/false; toggleSound makes soundEnabled false; setSoundEnabled(true) restores true; toggleSettings makes settingsOpen true.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/uiStore.test.ts -t "sound and settings"
